components.label: Couple the updates
components.name: Becoming.wholeNext
components.boundary: Imported definition: both updates respond to the exchange formed from the same joint state.

components.label: Lift the abstraction
components.name: Becoming.Readout.foldl_semiconj
components.boundary: Imported theorem: one-step commutation is a hypothesis; exact agreement for every finite plan follows.

components.label: Show information loss
components.name: no_attack_judge_from_remark, real_error_does_not_settle_attack
components.boundary: Application of no_judge_of_merged. Four possibilities and the wording-only observation are stipulated.

components.label: Gradual response and learning rules
components.name: Rules, revise, learned, turn, experience updates
components.boundary: Supplied behavioral definitions. The numbers are example evidence weights, not validated units of trust, trauma, maturity, or moral worth.

components.label: Retain both histories
components.name: History, view, step, both_pasts_retained
components.boundary: Both history lists grow. Older records contribute through learned; a setback changes their weighted summary without deleting them.

components.label: Exact abstraction across every finite plan
components.name: step_commutes and histories_and_scores_agree
components.boundary: The application imports Readout.foldl_semiconj. Exactness holds for these formal dynamics, not for every model of actual humans.

components.label: Repeated support and restoration
components.name: repeated_support and support_can_restore_lapse
components.boundary: General support restoration uses ExchangeLaw.sub_add_back under the bound that enough evidence existed before the lapse. Support must actually be acquired.

components.label: Why habit can restart the loop
components.name: habitual_defense, defensive_basin_closed, defensive_basin_forever
components.boundary: The basin is closed under the supplied habitual policy. A changed policy, environment, or deliberate clarification is outside that closure condition.

components.label: A lapse and the remaining margin
components.name: lapse_cost and margins_absorb_lapse
components.boundary: The sufficient margin theorem applies to arbitrary thresholds and setbacks. It does not assert that every late lapse leaves both above threshold.

components.label: Retry after an early lapse
components.name: early_lapse, early_lapse_habit_traps, early_lapse_repair
components.boundary: The exact retry schedule is three clarifications, a lapse, one new clarification, then three habitual replies. It ends at (3,5) under demoRules.

components.label: Later recovery and countercases
components.name: buffered_lapse, buffered_lapse_recovers, repeated_lapses_remove_buffer, larger_setback_counterexample
components.boundary: The standard setback is two. The larger-setback counterexample explicitly changes both penalties to six.

components.label: Accountability and evidence refinement
components.name: updated, sound_update_keeps_actual, confirmed_error_supports_accountability
components.boundary: Task evidence does not establish nonpersonal delivery. Coverage of reality, reliability, and the evidential permission rules are supplied.

components.label: Imported setback-margin lemma
components.name: Becoming.Copying.le_sub_of_add
components.boundary: A constructive arithmetic lemma imported by the general margin proof; no psychological meaning is provided by the lemma itself.

components.label: Imported subtraction restoration lemma
components.name: Becoming.ExchangeLaw.sub_add_back
components.boundary: A natural-number arithmetic result. Application to supporting evidence depends on the stipulated revise rule.

components.label: Full gradual application source
components.name: GradualInteractionTrial.lean
components.boundary: Exact source snapshot of the 23-theorem gradual extension. Earlier Boolean interaction results retain their separate original scope.
